8.7.2.2 ComM_ChannelWakeup
[SWS_ComM_00742] Definition of ClientServerInterface ComM_ChannelWakeup
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_09089
⌈
Name
ComM_ChannelWakeup
Comment
A SW-C playing the role of a "Mode Manager" can use this interface to configure the
Communication Manager Module to take precautions against awakening other ECU’s by
starting the communication.
IsService
true
Variation
{ecuc(ComM/ComMGeneral.ComMWakeupInhibitionEnabled)} == true
0
E_OK
Operation successful
Possible Errors
